questions.stem: Two similar triangles have corresponding sides of $6\text{ cm}$ and $15\text{ cm}$. What is the scale factor from the smaller to the larger?
Two similar rectangles have a length scale factor of $3$. The smaller rectangle has a side of $4\text{ cm}$. What is the corresponding side of the larger rectangle?
questions.explanation: Multiply the side by the scale factor: $4 \times 3 = 12\text{ cm}$.

questions.stem: In two similar triangles, a side of the larger triangle is $20\text{ cm}$ and the corresponding side of the smaller triangle is $8\text{ cm}$. Another side of the smaller triangle is $5\text{ cm}$. What is the corresponding side of the larger triangle?
questions.explanation: The scale factor is $\frac{20}{8} = 2.5$. The corresponding side is $5 \times 2.5 = 12.5\text{ cm}$.
